english.title: Driver of a motor vehicle fail to take 1st daily rest period of at least 3 consecutive hours - EC
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), and where the drivers' daily rest period was split, failed to take a first rest period of at least three consecutive hours as required by the first indent of Article 4(g) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD OF REST TAKEN..), in contravention of Article 8(1) of the EC Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.
